summary: 100-foot steel fire tower in Tuskegee National Forest, Macon County, Alabama; built 1936 per three sources (Register description says 1937); restoration work began at the site.

facts.design: 100-foot steel tower with 7 by 7 foot cab
facts.status_note: Standing as of the most recent dated item (March 2024 photo on the Register page). Restoration work has begun at the Taska Recreation Area site around the tower; the article is undated in the readable copy, and completion is not reported.

events.note: Built field on the NHLR page, the Forest Lookouts page and the Opelika-Auburn News article all give 1936. The NHLR description says 1937 (see resolved_conflicts).
Registered January 15, 2009 as US 757, AL 4; nominated by Thomas Kaufmann

evidence.supports: restoration Phase One and Phase Two began on a Thursday morning; about 20 people cleared brush next to the tower
evidence.quote: Restoration Phase One and Phase Two got a jump start Thursday morning as about 20 young people and adults cleared and piled up bush high over their heads next to the Pleasant Hill Fire Tower at the Taska Recreation Area.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1936 appears in the NHLR Built field, the Forest Lookouts page and the Opelika-Auburn News article. The NHLR description says the USDA Resettlement Administration Land Use Project built it in 1937. The story uses 1936 because three sources agree. The sources do not explain the difference.

sources.title: Work begins on restoration project at Pleasant Hill Fire Tower site

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on 1936 in some form, and the NHLR description gives 1937. The Opelika-Auburn article copy shows only its lede and a sidebar; the article body is encoded in the page and could not be read, and no publication date appears in the readable text, so the restoration has no event entry (no year). Staffing, fires, access and visit are not in any source and are omitted. The brief record matches the sources on county, coordinates, elevation (489 ft, 149 m), 1936 build, 2009 registration and agency. No photos added: the NHLR March 2024 photo has no image URL in the cached page. A search returned a Cecil County, Maryland post about a different Pleasant Hill tower; it was not used. Not verified: whether the restoration is complete and whether the tower can be climbed.
